title: NGO directory and official-site crosswalk
research_question: Which organizations are in the current U.S.-presence research subset and where can a reader verify their identity?
bounded_scope: Current active registry; freeze a clearly stated U.S.-related subset and checked-date website scope; no actor expansion
source_inputs: actor registry; source log; archived pages; existing frontend actor metadata
deliverables: selection frame; official-site crosswalk; unresolved-site queue; English/Japanese/Chinese directory export; validation report
principal_gate: Approve subset rule; approve official-site versus parent/directory/secondary labels
acceptance_tests: Every listed actor has an official-site status and evidence entry; 0 news/directory pages mislabeled official; row counts reconcile to frozen frame; URLs and checked dates validate
small_exhibit: Sortable NGO list with official-site/status/source columns
stop_condition: Stop if the subset rule cannot be reproduced from registry fields; return a decision brief rather than hand-picking actors
frontend_status: not_frontend_ready until separate publication adapter approval

title: Retype existing relation observations
research_question: What relation families are already supported and what remains only administrative aggregate event case-role or lead?
bounded_scope: Only existing 43 central relation observations plus linked R8/R10/AEV records; add no new facts
source_inputs: 15_funding_or_support_edges; typed relation projection; R8 roles; AEV; R10 relations; human review logs
deliverables: provenance crosswalk; proposed typed rows; rejected/ambiguous mapping queue; count reconciliation; validation report
principal_gate: Approve semantic mapping only; no status upgrade
acceptance_tests: All inputs accounted for exactly once as mapped/aggregate/lead/excluded; no co-event dyads; no opportunity-as-award; existing reviewed_fields preserved
stop_condition: Stop when a row needs a new factual judgment; create HR item instead of guessing

title: Garrison-reproduction tracer case
research_question: How do money affiliation and services combine to sustain military-family/base-community life in one place and period?
bounded_scope: One named installation/locality; one bounded recent period; a small predeclared set of existing service-side actors and recipient types
source_inputs: official organization reports; financial filings; official base/community records; existing reviewed relations
deliverables: selection frame; money/service/affiliation facts; function overlay; endpoint and source crosswalk; HR packet; validation; one case brief
principal_gate: Approve actor set; money semantics; recipient identity; garrison_reproduction wording
acceptance_tests: Every arrow has typed endpoints/time/source; in-kind and cash separate; unknown recipients visible; no stance/legitimation inference; reviewed and candidate counts separated
stop_condition: Stop at online_exhausted if annual recipient/filing is unavailable; issue exact local/new-primary task

title: U.S.-accountability tracer case
research_question: What can a procedural accountability action make the institution record or remedy and what does it fail to change?
bounded_scope: One case with a directly resolved U.S. military/government target; fixed procedural phases and outcome date
source_inputs: official caption/judgment/filing; formal submissions; existing R8/AEV facts; project/operation outcome record
deliverables: selection frame; action-institution rows; function overlay; outcome ladder; HR packet; validation; case brief
principal_gate: Approve roles; constraint/accountability distinction; intermediate output; substantive change status
acceptance_tests: Person and organization roles stay separate; non-party creates no edge; every phase has date/source; project change is independently evidenced; no success-rate claim
stop_condition: Stop if target/outcome cannot be independently resolved; publish a bounded procedural record only

title: Person-actor-time tracer
research_question: Who publicly occupies governance or coordination roles across selected organizations during overlapping periods?
bounded_scope: Two to four high-value existing organizations; one bounded period; public officers/representatives only
source_inputs: official filings; annual rosters; organization reports; court/government records; H2 research-only role seeds
deliverables: selection frame; person-role rows; identity crosswalk queue; overlap audit; HR packet; validation; short brief
principal_gate: Approve every same-person merge and each role/period boundary
acceptance_tests: No automatic fuzzy merge; annual sightings not continuous tenure; all projected interfaces have reviewed identity and overlapping period; unresolved candidates counted separately
stop_condition: Stop person search at privacy/inaccessibility boundary; do not expand to private family/member data

title: Recipient and community-mediation interface tracer
research_question: Through which intermediaries do resources reach Okinawan welfare education or community recipients and which observed transfers cross the base-local-society boundary?
bounded_scope: One resource intermediary; two to four disclosed cycles; all disclosed recipient labels in those cycles; predeclared boundary-side rules
source_inputs: original financial filings; annual reports; recipient rosters; recipient organization pages; H2 candidate rosters
deliverables: selection frame; money steps; service-recipient rows; community_mediation function overlay; endpoint crosswalk; disclosure/missingness audit; HR packet; validation; brief
principal_gate: Approve original-filing support; recipient resolution; boundary sides and direction; recurring relation wording; community_mediation wording
acceptance_tests: Named/unitemized rows separated; original labels retained; provider-intermediary-recipient steps not collapsed; only reviewed cross-boundary facts receive community_mediation; no recipient stance acceptance legitimation dependency or continuity; cycle denominator and undisclosed share reported
small_exhibit: Small-multiple recipient flow by cycle with separately marked reviewed cross-boundary interfaces
stop_condition: Stop if only aggregate totals are public; keep aggregate observation and create exact retrieval task

title: Legitimation evidence test
research_question: Does one charity or public-diplomacy case contain only service publicity or also explicit relationship-building and observable local reception?
bounded_scope: One event/program; actor narrative plus a prespecified search for recipient/local/independent response; fixed publication window
source_inputs: actor/official statements; recipient statements; local government or institutional record; independent media; no inferred attitude
deliverables: selection frame; one reviewed USN04 or USN06 underlying fact; L0-L3 function coding; negative search log; source clusters; HR interpretation packet; validation; brief
principal_gate: Approve L-level; source independence; wording of intent reception or effect
acceptance_tests: L0 never labeled legitimation; L1 wording says intent/frame; L2 identifies distinct reception source; L3 requires explicit method; counter-readings retained
small_exhibit: Two-column actor narrative versus local reception evidence card
dependencies: US-VS02 or another reviewed underlying fact
stop_condition: Stop at L1 if no independent reception appears; do not search indefinitely or upgrade official publicity to effect

title: Symmetric interface comparison
research_question: Within the same place and period what direct organization person and recipient interfaces are publicly observable between service/reproduction and accountability functions?
bounded_scope: Matched place/time; frozen function-observation-based groups; same source families and bidirectional queries for both groups
source_inputs: reviewed outputs from service/accountability/person/recipient slices plus explicit negative-search protocol
deliverables: matched selection frames; direct-relation comparison; person overlap; recipient crosswalk; source-family coverage; unresolved endpoint audit; HR negative-claim packet
principal_gate: Approve group rule; symmetry; negative wording; unresolved denominator
acceptance_tests: Organization/person/recipient zeros reported separately; query/source coverage equalized; temporal overlap enforced; source-silo sensitivity reported; no real-world absence claim
small_exhibit: Three-panel interface matrix: organization people recipients
stop_condition: Stop if frames are not comparable; report measurement asymmetry rather than a zero-interface conclusion

title: Bounded multilayer social network analysis
research_question: What brokers components and resource pathways appear within each reviewed layer and which persist under visibility sensitivity?
bounded_scope: Only layers that independently pass network_metric_eligibility; fixed time window and endpoint universe
source_inputs: reviewed slice outputs; selection frames; missingness and source-family audits
deliverables: layer-specific edge lists; metric eligibility report; reviewed-only metrics; candidate upper bound; source/time/unresolved sensitivity; methods brief; figures
principal_gate: Approve metric eligibility and interpretation; approve whether multilayer comparison is meaningful
acceptance_tests: No mixed-family single graph; reviewed primary/candidate sensitivity split; all metrics reproducible; source deletion and time-window sensitivity included; centrality never labeled influence/control
small_exhibit: Faceted layer networks plus robustness panel
dependencies: At least two completed fact slices; US-VS07 for cross-ecology claims
stop_condition: Stop if endpoint/time/coverage gates fail; retain directory and case pathways instead of forcing metrics
frontend_status: not_frontend_ready until a dedicated reviewed publication adapter is approved

title: 1972-2011 historical relation slice
research_question: Do present-day service/accountability/interface patterns persist across an earlier post-reversion period?
bounded_scope: One predeclared five-to-ten-year window and one locality/organizational field; local archive materials required
source_inputs: local newspapers; organization bulletins; annual reports; council records; archived directories; provenance scans
deliverables: historical selection frame; typed facts; endpoint/alias/genealogy crosswalk; source archive; HR packet; validation; comparative brief
principal_gate: Approve historical identities aliases periods and comparability with current slice
acceptance_tests: No current relation projected backward; historical names not auto-merged; archive selection bias stated; digitized-source absence not treated as inactivity
stop_condition: Stop if minimum primary-material set is not obtained; keep as formal local-retrieval task rather than online-exhausted conclusion
